reasoning: Aggressive momentum strategy concentrated in semiconductor and technology sectors riding historic uptrend. Overweight SNDK, INTC, and MU due to explosive returns and sustained momentum; these represent conviction bets on sector continuation. Add exposure to chip equipment (AMAT, ASML) and leaders benefiting from digital transformation (AMZN, GOOGL). Include recovery plays (MSFT, ORCL) showing both value and upside momentum. Small short in AAPL as hedge against tech sector valuations at cyclical peaks. Minimal cash reflects aggressive positioning where opportunities to deploy capital exceed safe alternatives.
